state_fields.name: ACTOR_MOVEMENT_ORIGIN_X
state_fields.read: subtract from the post-movement actor X coordinate

state_fields.name: ACTOR_MOVEMENT_ORIGIN_Y
state_fields.read: subtract from the post-movement actor Y coordinate

published_outputs: actor record offsets +0x1C/+0x1D receive the low-byte movement deltas
linked actors receive the same signed movement displacement in their position and delta fields
behavior: The two words are transient per-iteration MovementVM origin snapshots, not persistent actor or camera coordinates.
